subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are in a meeting, sitting around a round table facing the centre. H is sitting third to the left of E. D is sitting second to the left of A. A is sitting across H. B is a neighbour of H but not of D. C is sitting second to the left of B. F does not sit across D.Who is sitting across D?
solution:
1. H is sitting third to the left of E. D is sitting second to the left of A. A is sitting across H. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d08522b16f640cc8524f43efea41cef5136cebece1897e9c4e
c5de948a1ae5d9.png] 

2. B is a neighbour of H but not of D. Thus, B sits immediate left of H. C is sitting second to the left of B.&
